text: 男人终身都在“确认"战友，这是他们一辈子的课题。
en: Men spend their whole lives "confirming" their comrades-in-arms; this is their lifelong task.

text: 男人在规划任何一件事时，推演最多的情况就是：如果事情走向最坏的局面，在极端状况发生时，合作伙伴会怎么做？
en: When men plan anything, the scenario they game out the most is this: if things take the worst possible turn, when an extreme situation occurs, what would their partner do?

text: 也正因为如此，女人平时作一点，自私一点，都不算是什么问题，真正让男人在意的，不是这些日常里的情绪起伏，而是真出事的时候，你靠不靠谱。
en: Precisely because of this, a woman being a little difficult or a little selfish in ordinary times is not really a problem; what truly bothers men is not these everyday fluctuations of mood, but whether you can be relied upon when something actually goes wrong.

text: 男人的风险评估系统，跟女人天生就不一样。
en: A man's risk-assessment system is simply different from a woman's by nature.

text: 女人需要大量的日常行为，来确定自己是被爱的，而男人判断一段关系，从来不是平时的情绪价值，而是我“作战”时，能不能把后背交给你；我“负伤”时，你能不能把我从战场拖出来。
en: Women need a great deal of everyday behaviour to be sure they are loved, whereas a man judges a relationship never by the usual emotional value, but by whether, when I am 'fighting', I can entrust my back to you; and whether, when I am 'wounded', you can drag me off the battlefield.

text: 你可以耍脾气，闹情绪，甚至在日常里不太体贴，这些男人其实都能忍，但有一种错误是一次性致命的，就是关键时刻掉链子。
en: You can throw tantrums, be moody, even be a little inconsiderate in daily life; men can actually put up with all of that, but there is one mistake that is fatal in a single stroke, and that is dropping the ball at the critical moment.

text: 大家有兴趣可以留意一下，网上情感话题的评论区，男人分享的主动分手，或者离婚的原因，你会发现除了出轨这种情况以外，最多的一个原因就是，女人在他生病的时候，表现出了不耐烦。
en: If anyone is interested, they can pay attention to the comment sections of online relationship topics: the reasons men share for initiating a breakup or a divorce. You will find that, apart from cheating, the most common reason is that the woman showed impatience when he was ill.

text: 从进化心理学的角度来说，男人的角色是战士、猎人，对他生存构成最大威胁的，除了敌人和危险的猎物，就是自己在负伤时，战友不救助自己。
en: From the perspective of evolutionary psychology, a man's role is that of a warrior and a hunter; the greatest threats to his survival, apart from enemies and dangerous prey, are his comrades-in-arms failing to come to his aid when he is wounded.

text: 这一点在男性友谊里体现得最明显。
en: This is most clearly reflected in male friendship.

text: 男人对“战友”的要求极高，但一旦确认了身份，他的包容度也会高得惊人。
en: Men demand extremely high standards of their 'comrades-in-arms', but once the status is confirmed, their capacity for tolerance becomes astonishingly high.

text: 所以，哥们之间相处，可以嘴贱，可以互相占点小便宜、可以不那么体面。
en: So, between mates, you can be foul-mouthed, you can take small advantage of each other, you can be less than dignified.

text: 但只要在人生的关键节点，你扛事了，没有撂下他独自跑掉，那基本就等于拿到了“免死金牌”。
en: But as long as, at the key turning points of life, you stepped up and did not abandon him and run off on your own, that basically amounts to having been granted a 'pardon medal'.

text: 所以，很多男人真正寒心的瞬间，并不是伴侣跟他作和闹，而是他罕见的示弱了一次，对方没接住，让他第一次意识到，如果我倒下了，你可能会嫌我麻烦。
en: So, the moments when many men truly grow cold at heart are not when their partner is difficult and makes a scene, but when, on the rare occasion he shows weakness, the other person fails to catch it — making him realise for the first time: if I fell, you might find me a burden.

text: 这一刻，他是非常非常平静的，甚至会因为确认了危险来源，从而产生了安心感，因为他终于确认了一件事：对方不是战友。
en: At this moment he is very, very calm; he may even feel a sense of relief from having identified the source of danger, because he has finally confirmed one thing: the other person is not a comrade-in-arms.

text: 所以，他不会跟你吵，也不会当场翻脸，他只是默默在心里，把你从“战友名单”里划掉了，男人一旦在内心完成了这个判断，感情其实已经结束了。
en: So, he will not argue with you, nor will he turn on you on the spot; he simply, silently, crosses you off the 'list of comrades-in-arms' in his heart. Once a man has completed this judgement within himself, the relationship has in fact already ended.

text: 他可能还是会和你生活在一起，甚至依然会赚钱养家，依然会给你买礼物，但在他的内心深处，你从一个可以共命运的“战友”，降级成了一个“玩伴”，或者仅仅是一个需要他负责任的“被抚养者”。
en: He may still live with you, and may even still earn money to support the family and still buy you gifts, but deep in his heart you have been downgraded from a 'comrade-in-arms' who could share his fate, to a 'playmate', or merely a 'dependent' for whom he is responsible.

text: 这也是为什么，男人几乎不会因为“纪念日”和“仪式感”，这类事情表达失望，但一旦出现危机，反应就非常极端。
en: This is also why men almost never express disappointment over things like 'anniversaries' and 'a sense of ritual', but once a crisis appears, their reaction is extremely extreme.

text: 弄了个公众号：奇迹年。
en: Started a public account: Miracle Year.

text: 分享一些我比你先知道的事。
en: Sharing a few things I learned before you did.

text: 很多事情，很多道理，年纪到了都能会都能懂，但社会比的是谁先懂，早懂和晚懂是不一样的命运。
en: Many matters, many truths, can be understood once you reach a certain age; but society competes on who understands first — understanding early and understanding late are different fates.

text: 以下是我的其它回答，希望能对你有帮助。
en: Below are my other answers; I hope they will be of help to you.

text: 人生翻盘指南 - 4.3w赞
en: Guide to Turning Your Life Around — 43k likes

text: 人是怎么废掉的？
en: How does a person come to ruin?
— 42k likes

text: 以前我总怕男人花心
en: In the past I was always afraid of men being fickle.

text: 花心好像是他们的专属标签
en: Being fickle seemed to be their exclusive label.

text: 后来我才发现，原来女人也同样花心
en: Later I realised that women are just as fickle.

text: 就像亦舒说的
en: As Shu Yi said,

text: “人天性凉薄，只要拿更好的来换，没有什么舍不得的”
en: 'People are by nature cold and fickle; as long as something better is offered in exchange, there is nothing they cannot bear to part with.'

text: 其实我们要的很简单
en: Actually, what we want is very simple.

text: 只是想体验那种被坚定的选择的感觉
en: We just want to experience the feeling of being chosen with certainty.

text: 但是比较难的是
en: But what is rather difficult is,

text: 我们并不想坚定的选择对方
en: that we do not actually want to choose the other person with certainty.

text: 以前，我特别痛恨花心的人
en: In the past, I particularly detested fickle people.

text: 后来，我开始同情他们
en: Later, I began to pity them.

text: 花心的人并不快乐
en: Fickle people are not happy.

text: 至少不是踏踏实实的快乐
en: At least not a steady, settled happiness.

text: 谁不想一生一世一双人
en: Who does not long for one person, one lifetime, one pairing?

text: 你要知道，快乐的人是不会这样做的
en: You should know that happy people would not act this way.

text: 就像富裕的人不会去偷钱
en: Just as a wealthy person would not go and steal money,

text: 因为花心的人很难遇到自己真正喜欢的人
en: because fickle people rarely meet someone they truly like.

text: 因为他们不知道自己到底喜欢什么样的人
en: because they do not know what kind of person they actually like.

text: 可怜的是他们不仅欺骗别人
en: What is pitiful is that they not only deceive others,

text: 也欺骗自己，假装那是真正的快乐
en: but also deceive themselves, pretending that is true happiness.

text: 读的书越多，我越发现
en: The more books I read, the more I discover

text: 男人和女人本质上没有什么区别
en: that men and women are essentially no different.

text: 都不过是欲望的奴隶
en: Both are merely slaves to desire.

text: 没有谁更好，谁更坏
en: Neither is better, neither is worse.

text: 只不过是欲望不同罢了
en: It is simply that their desires differ.

text: 可是如果连欲望都战胜了
en: But if even desire were conquered,

text: 活着还有什么意思
en: what would be the point of living?

text: 欲望没有尽头
en: Desire has no end.

text: 走在欲望这条路上
en: Walking down the road of desire,

text: 我们都无能为力
en: we are all powerless.

text: 男人从原始时代就习惯了猎人的角色
en: Men have been accustomed to the role of hunter since primitive times.

text: 因此他们习惯追逐
en: Therefore they are used to the chase.

text: 在他们眼里，女人就是猎物
en: In their eyes, women are prey.

text: 我不喜欢做猎物担惊受怕的日子
en: I do not like the days of being prey, living in fear.

text: 我想做一个猎人，猎人要学会哄猎物开心
en: I want to be a hunter; a hunter must learn to cheer the prey up.

text: 猎物享受优待，但猎人有猎人的乐趣
en: The prey enjoys special treatment, but the hunter has the hunter's pleasures.

text: 没有必要去探讨什么是真实的一面
en: There is no need to probe what one's true self is.

text: 他喜欢我是他真实的一面
en: That he likes me is one true side of him.

text: 他用对我好的方式去对待别人
en: That he treats others with the same kindness he shows me

text: 也是他真实的一面
en: is also a true side of him.

text: 他有权选择这么做
en: He has the right to choose to act this way.

text: 我也有权选择离开
en: And I also have the right to choose to leave.

text: 越来越明白
en: I increasingly understand

text: 人是独立的个体
en: that people are independent individuals.

text: 他有权封闭那些内心阴暗的角落
en: He has the right to seal off those dark corners of his heart,

text: 不让我靠近
en: and not let me near.

text: 我也有我想一个人独享的秘密
en: I too have secrets I want to keep to myself alone,

text: 不想他知晓
en: secrets I do not want him to know.

text: 不需要对他的每个细枝末节都那么好奇
en: There is no need to be so curious about every tiny detail of him.

text: 如果什么都了解了
en: If one understood everything,

text: 也就无话可说了
en: then there would be nothing left to say.

text: 他不轻易流泪，也有同样生而为人的艰难
en: He does not weep easily, yet he too has the same difficulties of being human.

text: 要勇敢，要宽容，要承担责任
en: One must be brave, be tolerant, and take responsibility.

text: 要奋斗，不要轻易流泪
en: One must strive, and not weep easily.

text: 大抵上要比女人艰难很多
en: By and large it is far more difficult than it is for women.

text: 我一直都认为我的灵魂里住了一个男人。
en: I have always believed that a man lives in my soul.

text: 说一个秘密。
en: Let me tell a secret.

text: 当一个女人像一个男人一样强，并且有价值的时候，她会玩男人，但，不会爱男人。
en: When a woman is as strong as a man and has value, she will play men, but she will not love men.

text: 就是，当一个女人不需要，甚至不渴望从一个男人身上获取任何资源，她本身又很强的时候，她就会玩男人。
en: That is, when a woman does not need, and does not even crave, obtaining any resources from a man, and she herself is very strong, then she will play men.

text: 什么时候爱男人？
en: When does she love men?

text: 就是弱的时候，她爱男人，爱得死去活来，如痴如醉，撕心裂肺。
en: It is when she is weak: she loves men, loving them to death, utterly infatuated, heart-rending.

text: (有钱但精神残疾属于低级弱，钱也不会长久，很快就会被吞了。
en: (Having money but being spiritually disabled counts as a low-grade weakness; the money will not last and will soon be swallowed up.

text: 什么意思呢？
en: What does this mean?

text: 就是，强者不爱任何人，爱不上，看谁都想玩，但，爱不上。
en: It means the strong love no one; they cannot love, they look at everyone and want to play with them, but they cannot love.

text: 男女不是性别，是资源，权利，社会框架之下的教育，就是，没有什么男人女人一说，只有在某种框架之下，这一类人要养起来，让他们失去武力，好控制，奴役，匮乏，另一类人掌握他们。
en: Men and women are not sex; they are resources, power, and an indoctrination under the social framework — that is to say, there is no such thing as 'men and women'; only under a certain framework are one kind of people kept and nurtured so as to strip them of force, making them easy to control, to enslave, and to impoverish, while another kind dominates them.

text: 再直白一点，所有卑微的爱，都会忠诚。
en: To put it more bluntly, all humble love becomes loyal.

text: 奴役产生忠诚。
en: Enslavement produces loyalty.

text: 不是爱产生忠诚，是奴役产生忠诚，金钱利诱都不一定，唯奴役产生忠诚。
en: It is not love that produces loyalty; it is enslavement that produces loyalty. Money and temptation do not necessarily do so — only enslavement produces loyalty.

text: 女人之所以不能接受，无法爱上男人真实的一面是因为她们太弱了，假如，她们像男人一样，甚至比男人还强，她们会比男人会玩男人，还肆无忌惮，就像，她若能一拳头打碎石狮子，她绝对不会在武大郎面前战战兢兢，假如她们极其大，还占有社会资源，组建军队，她们比男人还能玩。
en: The reason women cannot accept and cannot love a man's true self is that they are too weak. If they were like men, or even stronger than men, they would play men even more recklessly than men do — just as, if she could smash a stone lion with one punch, she would absolutely not tremble before Dalang Wu. If they were extremely powerful and also held social resources and formed armies, they would be even better at playing than men.

text: 弱，不是说有钱了，有权了，就不弱了，而是，这个框架之下，她再强，也强不出这个框架。
en: Weakness does not mean that once you have money or power you are no longer weak; rather, under this framework, however strong she is, she cannot be strong beyond this framework.

text: 男女不是性别，不是，男女是权位。
en: Men and women are not sex; no — men and women are positions of power.

text: 假如，一个女的，总是今天爱这个，明天爱那个，天天失恋，嚎啕大哭，看吧，烂命一条，一辈子就在阴沟里栽跟头，没两个钢镚，被一个又一个男的耍得团团转，鸡毛噫也落不到半个，男的也一样，但凡为了哪个女的要死要活的，历朝历代，不是昏君就是亡国君，但凡，为了哪个女的，不好事业的，最后吃屎吃到粪坑里。
en: If a woman is always loving this one today and that one tomorrow, heartbroken every day, wailing and sobbing — look, a wretched life, spending her whole life tripping in the gutter, without two copper coins to her name, spun around in circles by one man after another, not even half a chicken feather to show for it; men are the same — any who live or die for some woman, throughout history, were either fatuous rulers or kings who lost their kingdoms; any who, for the sake of some woman, neglect their career, end up eating shit right in the cesspit.

text: 爱这个东西，就是卑微和乞讨，必然忠诚，一定忠诚，而且是下位，这个下位的产生，就在于，匮乏和弱，渴望从对方身上得到，求取，然而，这不是最重要的原因。
en: Love, this thing, is humility and begging; it is inevitably loyal, certainly loyal, and it occupies the lower position. The emergence of this lower position lies in scarcity and weakness, in the craving to obtain and seek from the other — yet this is not the most important reason.

text: 最重要的原因在于，他无法意识到，这个东西本来就是控制奴役他人用的，本来就是不断强迫灌输给一个微弱的婴孩和穷困的人的。
en: The most important reason is that he cannot realise that this thing was originally made to control and enslave others, that it was originally and continuously forced upon a feeble infant and a poor person.

text: 不然，穷人如何，或者女人如何去对冲她被人强行塞在这个架构里的压迫者的位置呢？
en: Otherwise, how could the poor, or how could women, offset the position of oppressor that was forced upon them within this structure?

text: 不然如何麻痹她，让她以为她需要的，她渴望的，她的价值就是爱与被爱，被男人认可呢？
en: Otherwise, how could she be narcotised into believing that what she needs, what she craves, her worth, is to love and be loved, to be approved of by men?

text: 而穷人有如何以为穷没关系，平平淡淡有爱才是真，才值得，才是宝藏呢？
en: And how could the poor be made to think that being poor does not matter, that a plain and simple life with love is the real thing, the worthwhile thing, the treasure?

text: 爱和性一样，它从来不是什么美好，尤其是性，它从一开始出现的目的，就不是为了给动物或者人高兴玩得，而是促使他们消耗自己的，也就是基因的目的，不是让雌雄happy的，而是用这个happy让主体复制繁衍自己的。
en: Love, like sex, was never anything beautiful; sex especially — its purpose from the very beginning was not to let animals or humans enjoy themselves, but to drive them to consume themselves. That is, the purpose of genes is not to make males and females happy, but to use that happiness to make the subject replicate and propagate itself.

text: 爱也一样，它的诞生，从来不是为了当事人的利益，甚至不是为了当事人后代的利益，而是，维稳，安定一个被剥削者的暴躁。
en: Love is the same: its birth was never for the interest of the person involved, not even for the interest of their descendants, but for stabilising and calming the irritability of the exploited.

text: 男女，不是性别，他是权位，女人无法爱上男人，或者疯狂的爱上男人，从来不是因为这个人本身，而是她那时那地的势与她的处境，举个例子，或者很多现实中，经常出现的，一个女孩，很穷，却很年轻的时候，很容易陷入爱情中，疯狂的爱上一个男的，然后在几年后，她骤然猛觉，气恼不已，妈的，那屎怎么吃得下？
en: Men and women are not sex; they are positions of power. The reason a woman cannot fall in love with a man, or falls madly in love with a man, was never because of the person himself, but because of the power and circumstances she had at that time and place. For example — and this often appears in reality — a girl who is very poor yet very young easily falls into love, madly in love with some man, and then a few years later she suddenly wakes up, full of irritation: bloody hell, how could I have swallowed that shit?

text: 这个过程，就是一个权位的变换，就是，她从一个低位，到了一个高位，等她到了这个高位的时候，她就很难再被一些不入流的把戏骗了，这也是为什么年龄越大的女人越难搞。
en: This process is a shift in position of power: she moves from a lower position to a higher one; once she reaches this higher position, she becomes hard to deceive with cheap tricks — which is also why the older a woman gets, the harder she is to handle.

text: 换句话说，乞讨者爱人，权位者用人，高位者玩人。
en: In other words: the beggar loves people, the powerful use people, the elevated play people.

text: 如果，一个女人总觉得非得谈点恋爱，或者非得有个男人，她要么穷，要么寂寞空虚，假如她非男人不可，那就是真穷(精神也是)，假如她想有个男人耍一耍，玩一玩，她就真牛逼了，她不是害怕恐惧，或者排斥，她要主动玩一玩，这娘们儿多半强得可怕的。
en: If a woman always feels she must be in a relationship, or must have a man, then she is either poor or lonely and empty. If she cannot do without a man, then she is truly poor (spiritually as well). If she wants to have a man to toy with and play around, then she is genuinely formidable — she is not afraid or repelled, she wants to take the initiative and play; such a woman is mostly terrifyingly strong.

text: 厌男排斥男，就是玩不过，和抱有期望，失望，这个实际上叫独善其身，独善离场，前面还有一句，也在其中。
en: To detest and reject men is simply being unable to outplay them, and harbouring expectations that end in disappointment; this is actually what is called tending to oneself alone and withdrawing from the field — there is a line before this that also belongs here.

text: 其实，这也叫务实，就是，玩不过，自知，主动退场。
en: In fact, this is also called being pragmatic: recognising you cannot outplay them, and taking the initiative to withdraw.

text: 然而，这也不是女人的错，因为，人无法逃离框架之内，大多数女人还是太弱了，连着身体也是，而男人总是疯狂地爱上玩他们的女人，而鄙夷抛弃爱他们的女人。
en: Yet this is not women's fault either, because one cannot escape the framework; most women are still too weak, even in body, while men always fall madly in love with women who play them, and disdain and abandon women who love them.

text: 慕强，人之天性，不分男女。
en: Admiring the strong is human nature, regardless of sex.

text: 弱，穷，才会渴望正义与公平，爱与奉献，歌颂这些，制定规则的人不会，也不需要，他只想玩，恨不得将这些人玩暴虐，因为他知道，奴役产生忠诚，产生爱，和崇拜。
en: The weak and the poor are the ones who crave justice and fairness, love and devotion, who extol these things. Those who make the rules will not, and need not; they only want to play, and would delight in playing these people to cruelty, because they know that enslavement produces loyalty, produces love, and produces worship.
